projects.name: OpenAirTwin
projects.tagline: An open-source digital twin platform for interactive wireless research.
projects.description: OpenAirTwin combines a Python backend, a browser-based 3D frontend, tile-based city scenes, and Sionna RT workflows to support interactive wireless research.
projects.image_alt: OpenAirTwin browser interface showing a three-dimensional Hong Kong city scene and wireless analysis controls

features.title: Link Analysis
features.description: Place transmitter and receiver points, solve propagation paths, and inspect received power, channel taps, CIR, and frequency response.

features.title: Mobility Simulation
features.description: Define receiver waypoints, speed, and sampling parameters to generate trajectories and time-varying channel results.

features.title: Radio Maps
features.description: Configure a receiver patch and resolution, then render a scalar coverage heatmap over the three-dimensional scene.

features.title: DeepMIMO Export
features.description: Draw a receiver region of interest, configure the grid, and export a DeepMIMO-compatible wireless dataset.

projects.citation: Wang, Z., Zhou, Z., & Zhao, Z. (2026). OpenAirTwin (Version 1.0.0) [Computer software].
